# Kanzulilm International

Premium online Islamic academy established in 2009 under Mufti Syed Muhammad Usman Bukhari. Offering 1-on-1 live Quran, Islamic studies, classical scholarship, and spiritual services via WhatsApp for students in USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and worldwide.

## Pages

### Core
- [Home](https://kanzulilm.com/) — Main portal for all courses, services, and enrollment
- [Privacy Policy](https://kanzulilm.com/privacy) — Data protection and privacy practices

### Quran & Foundational Courses
- [Online Madani Qaida Course](https://kanzulilm.com/madani-qaida) — Best online Madani Qaida for kids & adults. 1-on-1 certified Quran tutor via WhatsApp. Learn Tajweed, Nazra & Arabic. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Tajweed Course](https://kanzulilm.com/tajweed-course) — Best online Tajweed course for kids & adults. Learn Makharij, Sifat & all Tajweed rules 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Quran Translation Course](https://kanzulilm.com/quran-translation) — Best online Quran translation course. Understand Quran meaning with 1-on-1 WhatsApp classes. Certified scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Quran Tafseer Course](https://kanzulilm.com/quran-tafseer) — Best online Quran Tafseer course for kids & adults. Learn Quranic exegesis 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. PhD scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.

### Classical Islamic Scholarship (Dars-e-Nizami)
- [Online Dars-e-Nizami Course](https://kanzulilm.com/dars-e-nizami) — Online Dars-e-Nizami Alim course. Fiqh, Hadith, Tafseer, Aqaid & Arabic 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. PhD scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Arabic Course](https://kanzulilm.com/arabic-course) — Best online Arabic course for kids & adults. Quranic & conversational Arabic 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. Certified scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Nahw Course](https://kanzulilm.com/nahw-course) — Best online Nahw course. Learn Arabic grammar 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. Certified scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Sarf Course](https://kanzulilm.com/sarf-course) — Best online Sarf course. Learn Arabic morphology 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. Certified scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Persian Farsi Course](https://kanzulilm.com/persian-farsi-course) — Best online Persian Farsi course. Learn classical & modern Persian 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. Certified scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Online Seerah Course](https://kanzulilm.com/seerah-course) — Best online Seerah course. Study the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in depth 1-on-1 via WhatsApp. Certified scholars. Free trial. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.

### Spiritual Services
- [Online Istikhara](https://kanzulilm.com/online-istikhara) — Authentic online Istikhara for marriage & major decisions. Confidential scholarly guidance via WhatsApp. Free consultation. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.
- [Rohani Ilaj](https://kanzulilm.com/rohani-ilaj) — Authentic Rohani Ilaj — Quranic Wazaif, Ruqyah Shariah & Islamic spiritual healing. Confidential WhatsApp consultation. UK, USA, Canada, Australia.

## About

- Founded: 2009
- Founder: Mufti Syed Muhammad Usman Bukhari
- Teaching method: 1-on-1 live sessions via WhatsApp
- Faculty: Certified university-level Islamic scholars and PhD researchers with verified Ijazah (chain of transmission) in Tajweed and classical theology
- Session length: 30 minutes (structured for student attention and focus)
- Schedule: 24/7 global timetable supporting all time zones (US, UK, EU, AU)
- Trial: Free trial class available for all courses

## Services Summary

- Online Madani Qaida & Nazra Quran classes for kids and adults
- Online Tajweed — Makharij, Sifat, rules of recitation
- Online Quran Translation — meaning and understanding of the Quran
- Online Quran Tafseer — in-depth Quranic exegesis
- Online Dars-e-Nizami — complete Alim course (Fiqh, Hadith, Tafseer, Aqaid, Arabic)
- Online Arabic Language — Quranic and conversational Arabic
- Online Nahw — classical Arabic grammar
- Online Sarf — Arabic morphology
- Online Persian/Farsi — classical and modern Persian language
- Online Seerah — life and biography of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
- Online Istikhara — confidential Islamic guidance for major life decisions
- Rohani Ilaj — Quranic Wazaif, Ruqyah Shariah, Islamic spiritual healing
